referenceEvidence: The reviewed reference and contact sheet preserve the yellow crowned body, white paper crown, purple cape, anatomical-left cream boot and anatomical-right brown boot.

creamBoot.evidence: At the front it stays screen-right and becomes the near boot in left-facing views.

brownBoot.evidence: At the front it stays screen-left and becomes the near boot in right-facing views.

crownAttachment.evidence: The paper crown remains attached to the same top plane and rotates with the body.
